items.headline: Singaporean 'religious influencer' jailed 27 years and 10 months, plus 24 strokes, for abusing two boys
items.summary: A 37-year-old man who built an online following became a father figure to two brothers and was sentenced for raping and molesting them in 2022-2023 when they were aged six to 12.

items.headline: Indonesian woman jailed eight and a half years for a S$1.9 million cheating spree that began with Taylor Swift tickets
items.summary: Nila Anggraini Citra Sejati, 32, was sentenced for defrauding victims of more than S$1.9 million in a scheme that grew from fake concert tickets into investment cons.

items.headline: Ex-policeman loses appeal and gets a longer jail term over the fatal abuse of maid Piang Ngaih Don
items.summary: A 47-year-old former police officer had his sentence increased on appeal for abetting the abuse that killed Myanmar domestic worker Piang Ngaih Don in 2016.

items.headline: Eleven people aged 18 to 77 arrested in Singapore over an unlicensed moneylending syndicate
items.summary: Police detained eight men and three women suspected of helping a loan-shark operation with tasks such as opening bank accounts and moving proceeds.

items.headline: NUS makes a generative-AI module compulsory for freshmen and gives all students ChatGPT Edu access
items.summary: From 2026/27 NUS will require first-years to take an applied generative-AI course and roll out ChatGPT Edu campus-wide from Aug 31.

items.headline: China accused of blocking Indian patrols near Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh as Congress demands answers
items.summary: A fact-finding team alleges Chinese troops have denied Indian forces access to a patrolling point in Upper Subansiri since 2023; Congress chief Kharge pressed Modi to clarify.

items.headline: Modi's BJP overhauls its national leadership and names Piyush Goyal party treasurer ahead of state polls
items.summary: The BJP unveiled new office-bearers ahead of key state elections; Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal was named national treasurer.

items.headline: Indian short-tenor bond yields climb after the RBI moves to close a dollar-deposit window early
items.summary: Shorter-maturity government bond yields rose after the RBI said it would shut a special dollar-deposit window a month early, as oil pressured stocks.

items.headline: India begins its first caste census since independence, a count with high political stakes
items.summary: India's decadal survey is for the first time enumerating caste, a move analysts say could reshape political and welfare bargains.

items.headline: UK PM Andy Burnham exchanged messages with an impostor posing as Trump's chief of staff
items.summary: Burnham traded messages with someone impersonating White House chief of staff Susie Wiles before alerting authorities; the UK embassy raised it with the White House.

items.headline: Britain deploys about 100 troops to fight Welsh wildfires as Burnham unveils a farming support package
items.summary: Gurkha logisticians and engineers were sent to South Wales; the government added GBP50m to the Sustainable Farming Incentive, taking it to GBP290m.

items.headline: Debate over Cambridge professor Jason Arday's death intensifies days after he was found dead
items.summary: Arday, Cambridge's youngest Black professor, resigned Aug 5 amid plagiarism allegations and was found dead Aug 14; police called it unexpected but not suspicious.

items.headline: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon reportedly warns the UK chancellor against raising bank taxes
items.summary: Per an FT report relayed by Bloomberg, Dimon cautioned Chancellor John Healey against higher bank levies ahead of the Oct 28 budget.

items.headline: Trump scales back US military exercises with South Korea, citing Seoul's stance on Iran
items.summary: Trump said the US would reduce joint drills with South Korea, linking it to Seoul declining to help on Iran and to his ties with Kim Jong Un.

items.headline: Russia's top court upholds a ban on the anti-war Yabloko party and jails its deputy leader for 11 years
items.summary: The Supreme Court rejected Yabloko's appeal against exclusion from September's vote, and a separate court jailed its deputy head 11 years.

items.headline: Update: Kushner presses Netanyahu for over four hours to advance Trump's Gaza plan
items.summary: After meeting a Hamas delegation in Egypt, Kushner urged Netanyahu not to obstruct the ceasefire road map; Netanyahu tied any pullback to full Hamas disarmament.

items.headline: Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba ferry disaster kills at least 92, including 18 children
items.summary: An overloaded state-run vessel carrying an estimated 153 people, against a capacity of 90, capsized near Long Island, the country's deadliest such disaster.

items.headline: Nvidia backs up to $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI data center in Ohio
items.summary: Nvidia agreed to guarantee as much as $105 billion for a Pike County, Ohio campus OpenAI will lease from SB Energy, and will invest $1.5 billion in the developer.

items.headline: Stripe strikes a deal to buy AI model gateway OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items.summary: Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter, which routes across 400-plus AI models for eight million users, at over five times its $1.3 billion valuation from months earlier.

items.headline: AI video startup Higgsfield raises $400 million at a $5.4 billion valuation, quadrupling in months
items.summary: The DST Global-led round values Higgsfield at $5.4 billion, up from $1.3 billion; it reports $700 million annualized revenue and 30 million-plus users.

items.headline: Uber invests in Zipline, aiming for one million drone deliveries a day by the end of 2029
items.summary: Uber will add Zipline drones to Uber Eats, starting in Houston and Dallas; Zipline has made about two million deliveries to date.

items.headline: US stocks slip and oil jumps as the US-Iran truce window lapses without a deal
items.summary: The Dow fell about 273 points (0.5%) with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower, as Brent crude settled up 2.7% at $90.87 after a 60-day US-Iran memorandum expired.

items.headline: The dollar slides to a three-month low as traders trim bets on a September Fed hike
items.summary: The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index fell a third day to its weakest since mid-May, with September hike odds near one-in-three, down from about 75% in late July.

items.headline: S&P 500 second-quarter earnings jump 31%, the strongest outside a recession recovery
items.summary: Powered by Big Tech, blended Q2 profit growth beat forecasts of about 23%, cheering bulls even as some strategists question its durability.

items.headline: Nvidia shares reach about $225, a three-month high, lifting its 2026 gain past 20%
items.summary: Nvidia hit its highest level since mid-May as strong revenue growth at big AI customers eased worries over its financing commitments.

items.headline: 🏎️ Antonelli leads Hamilton by 50 points as F1 heads to a farewell Zandvoort sprint weekend
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli holds a 50-point lead over Lewis Hamilton, with George Russell third, into the Aug 21-23 Dutch GP, Zandvoort's last and its first sprint round.

items.headline: 🎾 Qualifier Jaime Faria stuns Ben Shelton in the Cincinnati second round
items.summary: Portugal's Jaime Faria beat sixth seed Ben Shelton 6-4, 6-4 in Cincinnati, saving all nine break points in the opening set.

items.headline: 🎾 Iga Swiatek opens her Cincinnati title defense with a 6-3, 6-0 rout of Emiliana Arango
items.summary: Swiatek dropped just three games; Sabalenka, Gauff and Rybakina also advanced.

items.headline: 🏏 Jadeja joins a rare 4,000-run, 350-wicket club as India build a lead over Sri Lanka in Galle
items.summary: Ravindra Jadeja took his 350th Test wicket to become the fourth player, and first India left-arm bowler, to the double; India led Sri Lanka by 178.

items.headline: 🏏 Babar Azam is a doubt for Pakistan's first Test against England at Headingley
items.summary: The Pakistan captain re-aggravated a right-hand injury in a warm-up; the board called it precautionary ahead of Wednesday's opener.

items.headline: A study of one million people links rare FNIP1 gene variants to a 60% lower cardiometabolic risk
items.summary: Exome data from 1M+ people found ultra-rare FNIP1-disabling variants track with a leaner metabolic profile; silencing the pathway in mice reproduced the benefit.

items.headline: NASA's TESS spots its first 'microlensing' planet, some 40,000 light-years away
items.summary: Astronomers found the world by revisiting archived TESS data after a Gaia alert, a new method suggesting more distant planets hide in its records.

items.headline: Scientists identify the single scent a naked mole-rat queen uses to keep rivals from breeding
items.summary: The queen emits isopropyl myristate, which suppresses reproduction in other females; adding it to a queenless colony stopped rivals fighting to take over.

items.headline: The world's largest solar telescope captures the sharpest images yet of the Sun's surface
items.summary: New Inouye Solar Telescope pictures resolve fine plasma streaks and swirls, signs of a Kelvin-Helmholtz instability, at unprecedented scale.

fun_fact.headline: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
fun_fact.body: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the first Moon landing than to the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza. The Great Pyramid was finished around 2560 BC, roughly 2,500 years before Cleopatra's reign, which ended in 30 BC, while the Apollo 11 landing in 1969 came less than 2,000 years after her death.

puzzle.title: Truth on the Island
puzzle.body: Knights always tell the truth, knaves always lie. P says at least one of the three is a knave; Q says P is a knave; R says Q is a knave. Identify each.
puzzle.approach: Test each speaker as knight then knave and keep the contradiction-free assignment.
puzzle.answer: P is a knight, Q is a knave, R is a knight.

word_puzzle.title: Head in the Clouds
word_puzzle.body: Letter Boxed. Top G/H/O, Right R/I/U, Bottom A/C/D, Left P/L/S. Chain two words using all 12 letters; consecutive letters from different sides; next word starts with previous word's last letter.
word_puzzle.approach: Find two chaining words that together cover all twelve letters.

notes: UK News and India ran on fallback sources (BBC/Sky and the India primary outlets were unreachable from the routine environment; UK used CNN/Bloomberg, India used Al Jazeera/Bloomberg). Singapore ran on Mothership because CNA/Straits Times deep URLs were not reachable via search. WebFetch was egress-blocked for news domains all run; verification relied on WebSearch snippets across allowed outlets. Roughly 3 retry passes were made per constrained section. No spectrum blocks today: three-way left/center/right outlet framings could not be independently verified under the source constraints. F1 currency confirmed: the Dutch GP is upcoming (Aug 21-23), so no stale race result was carried.
